Luca Moretti: Hey all — Luca here, first day on Eng-Platform! :wave: Really excited to be joining. I bring bad puns, a ukulele, and an unhealthy curiosity about office plants. I'll be in the SF office Tue/Thu to start. My badge is still en route — any tips for a temp desk pass? Also: tea or coffee debates welcome. :ukulele:
Avery Kim: Welcome Luca!! :tada: There’s a stack of temporary passes at reception, ask for ‘Redwood temp’. For desk plants, the south window by 3A has extra succulents if you want to adopt one.
Sam Price: Welcome — also team ukulele jam Friday lunch if you’re up for it. We have picks in the instrument drawer. :guitar:
Luca Moretti: Yes please to jam. I only know two chords but will bring snacks. Also does anyone have an extra mug? Mine didn’t survive the move. :grimacing:
Jenna Ortiz: Welcome! I’ll bring a spare enamel mug tomorrow. There’s an onboarding lunch at noon on Wednesday — meet at the big table in the kitchen.
Olivia Chen: Hi Luca — Olivia from People Ops. Quick reminder to fill the new-hire checklist (https://tiny.redwood/onboard). We’ve started your badge request; reception should have a temp pass if it’s delayed. Ping me if not. :sparkles:
Sam Price: @Luca Moretti bring a capo if you have one, but totally not required. Also we have a little ukulele sticker pack if you fancy decorating your laptop.
Luca Moretti: Thanks everyone — saved the checklist, noted the jam, and accepting mug & sticker offers with gratitude. See you all soon! :raised_hands:
Welcome Bot: Welcome message logged for Luca Moretti. Helpful links: handbook, calendar invite to new-hire lunch, benefits FAQ.
